description: Check how much USDC a DiviMail address has for sending email or paying. Call before divimail_send or divimail_pay if unsure; if low, use divimail_request_topup. No token needed, just the @divindi.io address.

email.description: The @divindi.io email address to check. Omit it when signed in: the connection already knows your address.

name: divimail_balance
